## Estimand and data

The Kaplan-Meier estimator describes the probability of remaining event-free beyond time $t$:

$$
\widehat{S}(t) = \prod_{t_i \le t}\left(1 - \frac{d_i}{n_i}\right).
$$

Here, $d_i$ is the number of events and $n_i$ is the risk set immediately before event time $t_i$.

## Fit the curve in R

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(survival)
dat <- read.csv("files/km-data.csv")
fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ arm, data = dat)
summary(fit)
```

## Interpretation

Report the time origin, event definition, censoring rules, analysis population, and uncertainty. A visually separated pair of curves does not by itself establish a clinically meaningful treatment effect.
